name: Alucard Eldritch
source:
Alucard is not your friend. He doesn't seem to have many friends at all. He's in love with the goth culture and its aesthetics, and he apparently sees being unapproachable as part of it. Does he have a hidden softer side? Oh, and they are fine with he and they pronouns.

[From [url=https://drliveordie.carrd.co/#alucard]official Carrd[/url]]
